mapper.select: SELECT employee.employee_id, employee_version.employee_number, employee_version.display_name AS employee_name, organization.organization_id, organization_version.name AS organization_name FROM employee employee JOIN employee_current_projection employee_projection ON employee_projection.employee_id = employee.employee_id JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_version_id = employee_projection.current_version_id AND employee_version.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{businessDate} ) JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND employment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND employment.effective_from < DATE_ADD(#{businessDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ( employment.effective_to IS NULL OR employment.effective_to > #{businessDate} ) JOIN organization_identity organization ON organization.organization_id = employment.organization_id AND organization.identity_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization_current_projection organization_projection ON organization_projection.organization_id = organization.organization_id JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_version_id = organization_projection.current_version_id AND organization_version.organization_id = organization.organization_id AND organization_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND organization_version.effective_from < DATE_ADD(#{businessDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ( organization_version.effective_to IS NULL OR organization_version.effective_to > #{businessDate} ) WHERE employee.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY employee.employee_id, employment.assignment_id

SELECT DISTINCT roster_employee.employee_id FROM employee roster_employee JOIN employee role_employee ON role_employee.employee_number = roster_employee.employee_number JOIN auth_principal principal ON principal.employee_id = role_employee.employee_id JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment assignment ON assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role role ON role.role_id = assignment.role_id AND role.role_code = 'EXECUTIVE' WHERE roster_employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND ( assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{asOf} ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT roster_employee.employee_id FROM punch_exemption_assignment assignment JOIN employee listed_employee ON listed_employee.employee_id = assignment.employee_id JOIN employee roster_employee ON roster_employee.employee_number = listed_employee.employee_number WHERE roster_employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND assignment.source = 'STANDING_LIST' AND ( assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{asOf} )

SELECT event.employee_id, event.point_instant, employee.employee_number FROM effective_attendance_event event JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = event.employee_id WHERE event.event_kind = 'PUNCH_POINT' AND event.point_instant IS NOT NULL AND event.point_instant >= #{windowStart} AND event.point_instant < #{windowEndExclusive} ORDER BY event.employee_id, event.point_instant
SELECT employee.employee_id, employee.employee_number FROM employee employee

SELECT employee.employee_id, employee_version.employee_number, employee_version.display_name AS employee_name, organization.organization_id, organization_version.name AS organization_name, account.account_type, account.balance_hours FROM time_account account JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = account.employee_id AND employee.company_id = account.company_id JOIN employee_current_projection employee_projection ON employee_projection.employee_id = employee.employee_id JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_version_id = employee_projection.current_version_id AND employee_version.employee_id = employee.employee_id JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employment.employment_period_id = account.employment_period_id AND employment.current_version_marker = 1 AND employment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization_identity organization ON organization.organization_id = employment.organization_id AND organization.identity_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization_current_projection organization_projection ON organization_projection.organization_id = organization.organization_id JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_version_id = organization_projection.current_version_id AND organization_version.organization_id = organization.organization_id WHERE account.company_id = #{companyId} AND account.account_year = #{accountYear} AND account.account_type IN ('ANNUAL_LEAVE', 'TIME_OFF') AND account.balance_hours < 0 ORDER BY employee.employee_number, account.account_type
